company.name: Bicycle AI
company.shortDescription: Bicycle is a full-stack customer support service provider.
company.description:
Bicycle AI use the best of machine intelligence with human supervision to provide an exceptional customer service experience.
Bicycle AI believes AI is the greatest tool that will enable people to do a better job. By taking over repetitive, simpler tasks AI can free their minds to solve problems that will have greater impacts. AI could also enhance their abilities to deal with complex problems by aiding in tasks that machines do better than us. They say let people do what they are best at and leave the rest to machines. They believe that AI is the bicycle for the mind for the future.
